text:
zane cole: FYI opened a docs PR to introduce a dynamic-batching migration guide and a new quant profile `faststream` (experimental) for lower-latency streaming. Old docs only mention ContinuousBatcher; this adds a hybrid pattern and cross-language snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024

vivian ng: Thanks @zane. Question: do we present dynamic batching as a separate pattern, or show the hybrid (ContinuousBatcher + dynamic windowing) which is what most teams should try first?

zane cole: show the hybrid as primary (recommended). Add a one-line legacy mapping for teams on old Batcher-only flows. Also call out that `faststream` is experimental and recommend pinning it for Dedicated deployments if used.

remy docs: CI note: the snippet extractor fails if we reference external CDN gists. Use internal paths for snippet extraction: `/examples/optimize/dynamic_batch/{go,py,js}`. Also ensure fenced code blocks include the language tag (e.g., ```go).

maria ramos: UX asks: can we include a tiny 2-row illustrative table (legacy vs hybrid) showing tokens/sec and p95? also please add a runnable microbench command for Go and Python. and add a short telemetry crosslink so users can see cost delta in Console.

zane cole: will add those. proposed microbench commands:
```bash
# Go
go run ./examples/optimize/dynamic_batch/go --profile faststream --mode hybrid
# Python
python -m examples.optimize.dynamic_batch.bench --profile faststream --mode hybrid
```

zane cole: proposed Go snippet (short):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
// hybrid: continuous batching front + small dynamic window
cb := optimize.NewContinuousBatcher(client, optimize.WithDynamicWindow(32), optimize.WithFastStreamQuant())
res, err := cb.Generate(ctx, "Summarize: ...", optimize.WithQuantProfile("faststream"))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```

vivian ng: Nice. Add a one-line fallback note: "If dynamic prefetch misses or batcher drains, requests fall back to the single-request path; expect ~1.6-2x p95." Also add a short paragraph about rollback: how to revert quant pinning in Dedicated config.

remy docs: left a small PR comment: add internal example paths for all languages, include language hints on fences, and add the telemetry crosslink `/console/telemetry/batching` with a short sentence: "Check token-level cost in Console to measure impact."

zane cole: fixed the snippet tags and replaced CDN links with internal example paths. added the microbench table (captioned as illustrative) and the Dedicated rollback blurb with crosslink to `/dedicated/configuration#quant-profiles`. Pushed.

zane cole: updated heading and added the telemetry tip + the Dedicated pinning note. ready for review.
